question: What is FNaF 1 4/20 worth under grid420 on the phone's measured costs over every night the model can deal -- not seeds 0-999 -- and does the route the tree runs today match the one that won?
answer: typical 65536/65536; worst 62052/65536 (94.684%); starved 0/65536 (0.000%). fnaf1-custom-night7-420-grid420 pins tools/fnaf1-device-lane.mjs as it stood at 3aaf02c; 3 commit(s) changed it since (c4014f0, dc21f09, e6de745), so this is the census of the file a re-run from the tree executes today, not of the file that won (fnaf1-winner.mjs re-runs that one).
whyItIsModelOnly: No device run. The lane drives the simulator through the costs in fnaf1-device-timing-moto-g56-v207.json, which states each one's claim level; it prices no detector error.

population.why: Fnaf1Sim seeds Rng, which keeps seed & 0xffff (packages/core/src/mechanics/rng.js); typical and starved draw one lateness sample per seed from laneRng(seed * 7919 + 17)

lanes.typical: each cost drawn from its band
lanes.starved: band maximum x (1 + 3u): a capture at a third of its rate, the screenrecord case

heldOutBlock.definition: every censused seed not in the design block

method.policy: grid420 with {"chicaByCamera":false}, the options fnaf1-custom-run.mjs hands it (PHONE_OPTIONS); night 7 at 20/20/20/20
